regeneration_rule: The recorded files are rewritten only by `python scripts/regenerate_sdf_prompt_equivalence_recorded_requests.py`, and only when the pull request is meant to change requests: never to make a failing test pass. Regenerate and commit the files in that pull request, and say in its description that requests change and why. A pull request not meant to change them leaves the files alone, so a difference is a bug.
